title: Restaurant and Café Website Cost UK: What You'll Pay in 2026
meta_title: Restaurant Website Cost UK 2026: Menus, Bookings, Orders
meta_description: UK restaurant and café websites cost £349–£3,000 to build. Menus, bookings, online ordering, and the savings versus 30% delivery app commission.

faq.q: How much does a restaurant website cost in the UK?
faq.a: Usually £349 to £750 for a simple site, £749 to £1,500 with bookings, and £1,499 to £3,000 with your own online ordering.

faq.q: Is my own online ordering cheaper than Deliveroo?
faq.a: Per order, yes: you pay card fees instead of a 30–35% commission. You still need to promote it to your customers.

faq.q: Should my menu be a PDF?
faq.a: No. A text menu loads faster on phones, can be read by Google and AI assistants, and is easier to update.

faq.q: Can I take table bookings on my website?
faq.a: Yes. A booking form or booking tool can handle tables, events and deposits for larger groups.

faq.q: How do I update my menu?
faq.a: On a care plan we update it for you; otherwise use a simple editor on your website.
